scale_reference_instruction: Fae idle frame was supplied only as a 280px source-pixel scale reference; no character was to be drawn.
prompt_summary: Full 3:2 playable 3/4 overhead cutaway bedroom, back wall and thin side walls, no front wall, open walkable floor, clear back-wall door, bed, craft desk, window, picture art without words, shelves, rug, and Maddie's cat bed. Watercolor washes, thin warm-brown ink, soft upper-left light, cozy pastel palette, no people, animals, text, UI, watermark, or 3D rendering.
selection_reason: The fourth Pro variant had the clearest door, strongest open-floor read, consistent 3/4 perspective, complete wall furniture, and the fewest illegible poster marks. It best matched the concept while preserving gameplay space.
post_processing: Owner-approved runtime scale (2026-10-05): 70% of the original 3000x2000 composition, so the back-wall door is about 1.4x Fae's height and the whole room fits on one phone screen.
